_meta.what_this_is: A query embedding and four document embeddings, the setup a dense retriever scores. Relevance is alignment with the query's DIRECTION -- two docs point the same way as the query (on-topic), two point elsewhere. One on-topic doc is deliberately small in magnitude and one off-topic doc is deliberately large, so the raw dot product (which multiplies alignment by magnitude) ranks them wrong while cosine (alignment only) ranks them right.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The vectors are hand-authored so the dot-product and cosine rankings, and the small-doc rescue, are exact and checkable; every dot, norm, and cosine is computed in cosine.py. d_big is off-topic but large (wins by dot), d_rel and d_small are on-topic (win by cosine), d_med is partly aligned.
_meta.format: query: the query vector; docs: [{id, vec, relevant}]; small_relevant: the id of the small on-topic doc the dot product buries.
